title: Beyond the Human World
summary: Ha-Jun and Kuro cross the dimensional threshold, stepping out of the human realm and setting foot into the Demon Realm for the very first time.

panels.shot: stepping through the swirling violet vortex
panels.action: Ha-Jun's boot steps across the shimmering dimensional membrane; space warps like liquid glass.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's boot steps across the shimmering dimensional membrane; space warps like liquid glass.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ka boot jhilmilati aayami jhilli ke paar chalta hai; antriksh taral kaanch ki tarah ghumta hai.

panels.shot: sensory overload in the interdimensional tunnel
panels.action: Surreal kaleidoscopic ribbons of violet, magenta, and obsidian light warp around Ha-Jun and Kuro in zero-gravity.
panels.prose_en: Surreal kaleidoscopic ribbons of violet, magenta, and obsidian light warp around Ha-Jun and Kuro in zero-gravity.
panels.prose_hi: Shunya-gurutvakarshan mein ha-jun aur kuro ke charon or bangni, magenta aur obsidian prakash tana ke avastavik bahurupadarshak reban.

panels.shot: exiting onto black obsidian cliff edge
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps out onto solid black volcanic glass; the dimensional rift closes behind him with a vacuum pop.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps out onto solid black volcanic glass; the dimensional rift closes behind him with a vacuum pop.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun thos kale jwalamukhi kaanch par kadam rakhta hai; aayami daraar uske peeche ek vacuum pop ke saath band ho jaati hai.

panels.shot: breathtaking panoramic reveal of the demon realm
panels.action: A colossal, awe-inspiring alien world: endless purple skies, twin shattered crimson moons, and jagged floating islands.
panels.prose_en: A colossal, awe-inspiring alien world: endless purple skies, twin shattered crimson moons, and jagged floating islands.
panels.prose_hi: Ek vishal, vismaykari videshi duniya: antaheen baingani aasman, judwan toote hue lal chandrama, aur dantedar tairte dweep.

panels.shot: colossal ruins of ancient obsidian citadel in distance
panels.action: Ten miles away across a sea of glowing crimson mist rises Necrothea: towering 2,000-foot inverted obsidian spires.
panels.prose_en: Ten miles away across a sea of glowing crimson mist rises Necrothea: towering 2,000-foot inverted obsidian spires.
panels.prose_hi: Chamkati lal rang ki dhundh ke samudra ke paar das meal door necrothiya ugta hai: 2,000 foot oonche ulte obsidian shikhar.

panels.shot: rivers of liquid crimson mana glowing below
panels.action: Deep in the canyon beneath the cliff, glowing rivers of pure liquid mana flow like luminous red arteries.
panels.prose_en: Deep in the canyon beneath the cliff, glowing rivers of pure liquid mana flow like luminous red arteries.
panels.prose_hi: Chattan ke neeche gahri ghati men, shuddh taral maina ki chamakti nadiyan chamakdar lal dhamniyon ki tarah bahti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun gasping as alien air fills his lungs
panels.action: Ha-Jun takes his first breath: the air is thick with pure, unadulterated mana, vibrating like electric champagne.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh hawa... Itni dense mana hai ki mere saare cells vibrate kar rahe hain!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun takes his first breath: the air is thick with pure, unadulterated mana, vibrating like electric champagne.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apni pehli saans li: hawa shuddh, shuddh man se bhari hui hai, jo electric shampane ki tarah kampan kar rahi hai.

panels.shot: ring of hollow blood expanding with crimson aura
panels.action: The obsidian ring drinks in ambient mana, flaring with twice its normal radiance.
panels.prose_en: The obsidian ring drinks in ambient mana, flaring with twice its normal radiance.
panels.prose_hi: Obseedian ring pariveshiy man ko peeti hai, apni samanya chamak se doguni chamakti hai.

panels.shot: bone gauntlet whitening to pristine porcelain
panels.action: The bone gauntlet absorbs calcium minerals from the air, its surface hardening into flawless porcelain.
panels.prose_en: The bone gauntlet absorbs calcium minerals from the air, its surface hardening into flawless porcelain.
panels.prose_hi: Haddi ka gauntlet hawa se calcium khanijon ko avshoshit karta hai, iski satah sakht hokar nirdosh chini mitti ke bartan mein badal jaati hai.

panels.shot: kuro stretching wings to full 10-foot majesty
panels.action: In the native demon air, Kuro's body naturally expands; demonic horns curve back with blazing purple tips.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Aaaahhh! 500 saal baad... Finally real home atmosphere!

panels.prose_en: In the native demon air, Kuro's body naturally expands; demonic horns curve back with blazing purple tips.
panels.prose_hi: Deshi danav vayu men, kuro ka shareer swabhavik roop se failta hai; rakshasi seeng chamakdar baingani yuktiyon ke saath peeche mude hue han.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling at kuro transformation
panels.action: Ha-Jun chuckles softly: 'Lagta hai yahan aakar tum zyada handsome lag rahe ho, Kuro.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun chuckles softly: 'Lagta hai yahan aakar tum zyada handsome lag rahe ho, Kuro.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun dheere se hanste han: 'lagata hai yahan aakar tum jyada handsome lag rahe ho, kuro.'

panels.shot: kuro smirking with beak
panels.action: Kuro puffs out his chest: 'Handsome? Main legendary Vanguard hoon! Respect the horns!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ab niche dekho... Tae-Jun ke footprint trails yahan se start ho rahe hain.

panels.prose_en: Kuro puffs out his chest: 'Handsome? Main legendary Vanguard hoon! Respect the horns!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apni chhati fulakar kaha: 'sunder? mukhya pauranik vanguard hun! seengon ka samman karen!'

panels.shot: ha-jun looking down at black cliff path
panels.action: On the dark obsidian stone path, glowing red footprints lead directly toward the ancient citadel ruins.
panels.prose_en: On the dark obsidian stone path, glowing red footprints lead directly toward the ancient citadel ruins.
panels.prose_hi: Gahre obsidian patthar ke raste par, chamakte lal pairon ke nishan sidhe prachin gadh ke khandharon ki or le jaate han.

panels.shot: eerie silence broken by distant titanic roar
panels.action: From somewhere beyond the floating islands, a titanic seismic roar echoes across the crimson clouds.
panels.prose_en: From somewhere beyond the floating islands, a titanic seismic roar echoes across the crimson clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Tairte hue dweepon ke paar kahin se, lal baadalon ke paar ek vishal bhukampiy garjana goonjati hai.

panels.shot: giant shadow passing across twin moons
panels.action: A colossal winged silhouette the size of a commercial airliner glides effortlessly across the broken moon.
panels.prose_en: A colossal winged silhouette the size of a commercial airliner glides effortlessly across the broken moon.
panels.prose_hi: Ek vanijyik viman ke aakaar ka ek vishal pankhon wala chhayachitra toote hue chandrama par sahajta se udta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes tracking the sky beast
panels.action: Ha-Jun watches with keen, analytical interest rather than fear: 'Abyssal Dragon...?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Insaani world se bohot alag hai yahan... Sabkuch primal hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun watches with keen, analytical interest rather than fear: 'Abyssal Dragon...?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun dar ke bajay gahri, vishleshnatmak dilchaspi se dekhta hai: 'abisal dragon...?'

panels.shot: system quest interface activating with purple flame
panels.action: The Sovereign Interface unfolds in gothic demonic script, bordered with dark amethyst fire.

dialogue.text:
[ENTERED REALM: THE NETHER ABYSS - NECROTHEA REGION]
Realm Pressure: High (Sovereign Bloodline Buff: +50% Mana Recovery)
Primary Quest: Infiltrate the Forgotten Citadel.
Reward: Relic #5 - The Fang of Abyss.

panels.prose_en: The Sovereign Interface unfolds in gothic demonic script, bordered with dark amethyst fire.
panels.prose_hi: Soweren interface gothic rakshasi lipi mein prakat hota hai, jo gahre neelam ki aag se ghira hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun reading the buff notification
panels.action: Ha-Jun reads the stats: '+50% Mana recovery... Iska matlab main freely combat techniques use kar sakta hoon.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reads the stats: '+50% Mana recovery... Iska matlab main freely combat techniques use kar sakta hoon.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aankde padhta hai: '+50% maina rikvari... iska matlab hai ki main swatantra roop se yudh taknikon ka upyog kar sakta hun.'

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto ha-jun shoulder
panels.action: Kuro folds his massive wings: 'Lekin overconfident mat hona. Is realm ke Lesser Demons bhi Earth ke S-Rank monsters se zyada vicious hain.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Har creature yahan Sovereign ka blood taste karna chahta hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro folds his massive wings: 'Lekin overconfident mat hona. Is realm ke Lesser Demons bhi Earth ke S-Rank monsters se zyada vicious hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apne vishal pankh mode: 'lakin atiaatmvishwas mat hona. kya duniya ke chhote rakshas bhi prithvi ke s-rank rakshason se jyada shatir han.'

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping onto descending obsidian path
panels.action: Ha-Jun begins descending the spiraling mountain trail toward the glowing red valley.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun begins descending the spiraling mountain trail toward the glowing red valley.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun chamakdar lal ghati ki or ghumavdar parvat path se utarna shuru karta hai.

panels.shot: strange alien flora along path
panels.action: Bioluminescent dark purple ferns that glow when touched; crystalline thorny brambles leaking blue sap.
panels.prose_en: Bioluminescent dark purple ferns that glow when touched; crystalline thorny brambles leaking blue sap.
panels.prose_hi: Bioluminsent gahre baingani fern jo chhune par chamakte han; crystaliy kantedar brambals se neela ras ris raha hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun gently brushing a glowing fern
panels.action: As Ha-Jun's fingers brush a purple fern, it blossoms into tiny floating firefly-like mana spores.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh plants... Mujhe dushman nahi samajh rahe. Mere bloodline ko recognise kar rahe hain.

panels.prose_en: As Ha-Jun's fingers brush a purple fern, it blossoms into tiny floating firefly-like mana spores.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi ha-jun ki ungaliyan baingani fern ko brush karti han, yah chhote tairte jugnu jaise maina bijanuon mein khil jata hai.

panels.shot: kuro noting the plant reaction
panels.action: Kuro nods: 'Kyunki yeh pura realm First Sovereign ke mana se grow hua tha. Tum is realm ke rightful heir ho.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Zameen tumhare qadmon ko pehchaanti hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro nods: 'Kyunki yeh pura realm First Sovereign ke mana se grow hua tha. Tum is realm ke rightful heir ho.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne sir hilaya: 'kyonki yeh pura kshetra first sovereign ke man se grow hua tha. tum is kshetra ke asli uttaradhikari ho.'

panels.shot: reaching the valley entrance: the bridge of souls
panels.action: The mountain path ends at an immense bridge made of solid translucent bone spanning a mile-wide chasm.
panels.prose_en: The mountain path ends at an immense bridge made of solid translucent bone spanning a mile-wide chasm.
panels.prose_hi: Pahadi rasta ek meal chaudi khai mein faile thos parabhasi haddi se bane vishal pul par samapt hota hai.

panels.shot: bridge guarded by six gargantuan demon sentinels
panels.action: Six 12-foot stone-and-obsidian Sentinels in rusted armor stand at attention with colossal halberds.
panels.prose_en: Six 12-foot stone-and-obsidian Sentinels in rusted armor stand at attention with colossal halberds.
panels.prose_hi: Jang lage kavach mein chhah 12 foot ke patthar aur obsidian prahari vishal halbard ke saath dhyan mein khade han.

panels.shot: sentinel eyes igniting as ha-jun approaches
panels.action: The stone guardians' hollow eye sockets ignite with twin violet flames; halberds lift in salute.
panels.prose_en: The stone guardians' hollow eye sockets ignite with twin violet flames; halberds lift in salute.
panels.prose_hi: Patthar ke rakhwalon ki khokhli aankhen judwan baingani lapton se prajvalit hoti han; helbard salaam mein uthate han.

panels.shot: all six sentinels dropping to one knee
panels.action: The colossal statues sink to their stone knees in synchronized reverence, clearing the bridge path.

dialogue.text: Hazaaron saal baad... The Sovereign has returned to his kingdom.

panels.prose_en: The colossal statues sink to their stone knees in synchronized reverence, clearing the bridge path.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal murtiyan samkalik shraddha mein apne patthar ke ghutnon tak doob jaati han, jisse pul ka rasta saaf ho jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking between the kneeling giants
panels.action: Ha-Jun walks between the massive kneeling sentinels, his black jacket billowing in the abyssal wind.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun walks between the massive kneeling sentinels, his black jacket billowing in the abyssal wind.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun vishal ghutnon ke bal baithe prahari ke beech chalta hai, uski kali jacket tez hawa mein lahra rahi hai.

panels.shot: citadel gates of necrothea looming ahead
panels.action: At the far end of the bridge, the 300-foot obsidian gates of Necrothea stand open, glowing with purple mist.
panels.prose_en: At the far end of the bridge, the 300-foot obsidian gates of Necrothea stand open, glowing with purple mist.
panels.prose_hi: Pul ke door ke chhor par, necrothiya ke 300 foot ke obsidian dwar khule khade han, jo baingani dhundh se chamak rahe han.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up at the citadel with unbreakable resolve
panels.action: Ha-Jun reaches the threshold of his ancestral capital: 'Main aa gaya hoon. Apne bhai ko wapas lene... Aur apna haq lene.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Necrothea... Show me what my ancestors left behind.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reaches the threshold of his ancestral capital: 'Main aa gaya hoon. Apne bhai ko wapas lene... Aur apna haq lene.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni patrik rajdhani ki dahalij par pahunchta hai: 'main aa gaya hun. apne bhai ko wapas len... aur apna haq len.'
